input.question: Who is the artist of the album "Without You I'm Nothing"?

documents.text: Without You I'm Nothing (Sandra Bernhard album) Without You I'm Nothing is the title of the second record released by comedian and singer Sandra Bernhard. It was released at the height of her career and is a live performance recording that was issued on double-cassette, compact disc and double-vinyl in 1989; it was later re-released on double-compact disc and made available for sale on Bernhard's own website. The re-release included a second disc of bonus material. The original release once fetched upwards of $300 at auction because a then-unknown Tori Amos is featured singing backing vocals on the track "Little
